Bar Cuba in Sankt Anton am Arlberg

** Welcome to **Bar Cuba**, your cozy spot in the heart of **Sankt Anton am Arlberg**! Whether you're craving a cold drink after a day on the slopes or a hearty meal to fuel your adventures, we’ve got you covered. Sip on a refreshing **Cuba Libre** or enjoy a classic **Tiroler Gröstl**—our menu blends international flavors with local favorites. Try our famous **Kaiserschmarrn** for breakfast or a juicy **Schweinsbraten** with **Kräuterknödel** and **Semmelknödel** for dinner. After a long day in the mountains, unwind with a warm **Glühwein** or a crisp **Tiroler Bier**. Our friendly team is always happy to help you plan your next adventure—whether it’s skiing in **Lech-Zürs** or exploring the charming villages of the **Arlberg**. Come by for a drink, a bite, or just to soak up the alpine vibe—**Bar Cuba** is your home away from home in **Sankt Anton am Arlberg**!
